subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be exposed as a separate `dmThreadMode` account setting, folded into the existing `replyToMode` threading contract, or held until stronger live Google Chat proof exists?
rationale: This changes a user-facing config surface and intentionally reopens a Google Chat DM thread path that was previously removed after real delivery failures, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product API.

options.title: Decide the config API first
options.body: Choose the intended threading contract before merge, then require the branch to complete types, generated metadata, docs, and live proof for that contract.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` as separate
options.body: Keep the new DM-only knob, but make the contributor finish the config contract and prove default plus opt-in Google Chat DM behavior in a real setup.

options.title: Fold or pause behind `replyToMode`
options.body: Reject the parallel config key for now and handle DM threading only through the existing Google Chat threading/off-mode work if maintainers want that behavior.

recommendation.title: Decide the config API first
recommendation.body: Choose the intended threading contract before merge, then require the branch to complete types, generated metadata, docs, and live proof for that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and verified the prior DM thread-suppression path and has recent ownership signals on adjacent Google Chat threading behavior.
